units.title: Product stereographic model
units.classification: Shared sphere-calculus support interface; definitions are not theorem credit
units.statement: Write \(E_n=\mathbb R^{n+1}\), \(S_n=\{x\in E_n:\|x\|=1\}\), and \(M_{n,N}=S_n^{\operatorname{Fin}N}\). The dimensions are natural numbers and may be zero. This is the finite product of the ordinary sphere models \(\mathcal R_n\). Its model vector space is \((\mathbb R^n)^{\operatorname{Fin}N}\); ModelPi carries the product model topology. It specifies the actual ContMDiff regularity convention.
assumptions: Use the indicated canonical real Euclidean, unit-sphere and finite-product carriers; no positive-dimension restriction is imposed.
This is a definition or abbreviation. It imposes no unstated regularity, tangency, integrability or probability hypothesis.
